title: Our Family Jobs
text:
My mother is a nurse. She works at a small clinic in our town. Every morning, she checks the patients and helps the doctor. She likes her job very much.

My father is an engineer. He designs roads and bridges. He works in an office with many computers. In the evening, he builds model cars with my brother.

options: At a big hospital in the city
At a small clinic in our town
At a school near the park

questions.text: How does the mother feel about her job?
What can we guess about the father's evenings?
options: He spends time with his family and hobbies
He does not have free time

vocabulary.definition: a person who cares for sick or injured people
a small place where people go for medical treatment
a person who designs and builds machines, roads or bridges
a room or building where people work at desks

paragraph_translations: Annem bir hemşire. Kasabamızdaki küçük bir kliniğte çalışıyor. Her sabah hastaları kontrol eder ve doktora yardım eder. İşini çok sever.
Babam bir mühendis. Yollar ve köprüler tasarlar. Birçok bilgisayarın olduğu bir ofiste çalışır. Akşamları kardeşimle model arabalar yapar.
